description: Open one niche: its gloss with labeling confidence, size, the distribution of its members over quality index bands, scale bands, growth bands, countries and site types in whole percents, its position in the hierarchy — parent, children, neighboring niches — and a stable sample of member projects as cards. Opening the niche itself spends no coverage; every parent, child, neighbor and sample member shown to your organization for the first time this period costs the first-seen price on top of the base price and spends one unit of coverage, so ask only for the parts you need. Use the hierarchy to widen or narrow the market definition instead of searching again. It takes a niche id: to find a niche by words or by conditions use search_cohorts.

cohort_id.description: Niche to open; required unless quote_token is given

estimate.description: When true, run the query but return only its composition, price and a quote_token instead of data

parts.description: Which sections to include; all when omitted

quote_token.description: Execute a previous estimate: pass the quote_token instead of the query parameters

sample_limit.description: Members in the sample; defaults to the limit named sample in capabilities and is refused above it

sample_sort.description: distance (default): the most typical member and the core members nearest to it; index: the core members with the highest quality index

name: get_cohort
title: Open a niche
